parsed.note_claim: The image is edited and 'Latinos for Trump 2024' was added digitally to the original photo.
parsed.label: PARTIAL
parsed.quote: However, an unknown user doctored the photo with the "Latinos for Trump 2024" logo. The same user altered the agents' uniforms to read "ICE," when the original picture showed "HSI" for Homeland Security Investigations.
parsed.reason: The page directly substantiates that the image is doctored and the shirt logo was added digitally, but it contradicts the note's specific claim that the original was a '2020 AP photo of a Georgia arrest,' stating instead it was a 2018 ICE/HSI photo from Ohio.
